title: Mirror of Two Selves
description: A surreal painting shows a young woman with long braided hair split between two realities within an ornate oval mirror. On the left she sits in bed wearing a patterned bandana and pink bikini top, taking a selfie; on the right she stands outdoors in a wheat field wearing cat ears, face paint, and overalls while holding a cardboard box labeled 'FRAGILE! SMELLS INSIDE!' next to a red mailbox marked E. Voss.
prompt: A surreal painting in an ornate oval golden frame depicts the same young woman with very long thick braided hair connecting two scenes. On the left side inside a bedroom she sits up in floral bedding wearing a patterned bandana and orange-pink bikini top while taking a selfie with a pink phone. On the right she stands in a sunny wheat field wearing cat ears and whiskers, blue overalls over the same bikini top, holding a cardboard box that says FRAGILE! SMELLS INSIDE next to an open red mailbox labeled E. Voss. Soft natural light, detailed textures, whimsical and slightly unsettling atmosphere.
